ruff_scope_equivalence: The AGENTS server/clients/tools lint command is split into server+extensions and clients+tools steps. Both check and format variants completed successfully in both gates.

workflow_scope.only_workflow_difference: The merge checkout adds an explanatory comment and increases the launcher job timeout from 30 to 60 minutes.

real launcher full mode on both operating systems

tls_contract_source_identity.basis: Only the historical source contract is compared, never a prior CI result. Both new exact refs have the same Git blob and source bytes as the retained baseline.
tls_contract_source_identity.contracts_preserved: Live ClientHello; TLS stall elapsed below 1.5 seconds and deadline classification; early peer-close remains connection failure with sent false and remaining budget over one second; cancel/scope workers stop; HTTPS JSON/download deadline and cancellation assertions remain unchanged.

quiet_suite_skip_and_tls_proof.proof_type: Source-anchored inference from full discovery, mandatory skip conditions and exact aggregate outcomes; quiet logs do not print successful individual test names or individual elapsed values.
quiet_suite_skip_and_tls_proof.aggregate_evidence: All four Linux full suites report exactly three skips. The three discovered Windows-only methods must skip on Linux and exhaust that count. Both Windows full suites report OK with no skip count (zero). Therefore no additional TLS/HTTPS fixture skip occurred in any of the six successful full suites.
quiet_suite_skip_and_tls_proof.real_transport_source: The source uses a loopback ThreadingHTTPServer, checks a live TLS ClientHello, and wraps the server socket with an SSLContext for HTTPS. It is not only a mock-transport suite.
quiet_suite_skip_and_tls_proof.openssl_fixture_condition: The HTTPS fixture can raise SkipTest only when neither OpenSSL on PATH nor Git-bundled OpenSSL is available. No such additional skip occurred, as proven by the aggregate counts.

covered_methods.assertions: A live ClientHello is received, elapsed is below 1.5 seconds, and the error is a deadline.
A live ClientHello is received; remaining budget is over one second; connection failure, not deadline; sent is false.
Both cancel and scope close interrupt the TLS worker; the worker is no longer alive after the 0.4-second join and reports cancellation.
HTTPS JSON and download bodies both use the absolute-deadline stall check.
Both cancellation methods interrupt both HTTPS body variants.

quiet_suite_skip_and_tls_proof.other_known_environment_guards: Launcher test_syntax requires sh and is explicitly ok in all four verbose launcher logs. The API generated-client check requires ruff; ruff is installed in the CI dependency step, and no residual skip capacity remains.
quiet_suite_skip_and_tls_proof.limitations: No separate TLS-only job or new local test was run. Numeric per-test elapsed values are not present in successful quiet logs; only their source assertions and suite success are established.

observation.local_activity: Standard-library evidence processing and read-only gh API/log retrieval only; no local product import/test/lint/build/service/browser/HTTP product call; no rerun/cancel/push/source/workflow edit.

release_smoke_limit: Both release builds succeeded and produced archive size/hash evidence. The logs explicitly warn that the smoke manifest is unsigned, so this is not a signed-update acceptance test.
